title: Information and Communication Technology - Reading Book, Grade 6 (English medium)
edition: EPD, first print 2018, second print 2019 (ISBN 978-955-25-0088-6); listed on edupub as 'New Syllabus' = the 2018 ICT syllabus, NOT the 2026/2027 reform
notes: edupub book id 1787 (Textbooks Download > English > Grade 6). 6 chapters, pp. 1-78 (PDF page = book page + 9). Only Grade 6 ICT textbook on edupub; no reformed (2026) ICT module is published there as of 2026-11-13.

title: Information and Communication Technology - Workbook, Grade 6 (English medium)
notes: edupub book id 1788. Companion to the Reading Book; activities numbered by chapter (1.1-6.2), pp. 1-55 (PDF page = book page + 8).

title: Information and Communication Technology Teachers' Guide, Grade 6 (Effective from 2018)
edition: NIE Department of Information Technology, first print 2018
notes: Found via nie.lk/seletguide (English medium, Grade 6) as 'Information Communication Technology -ICT (2018)'. Contains the Grade 6 syllabus (pp. 1-4), term/period plan (p. xi) and per-competency-level guidance (pp. 6-71). PDF page = printed page + 11.

title: Grade 6 ICT syllabus (contained in the Teachers' Guide)
notes: No separate ICT syllabus is listed on nie.lk/selesyll for Grade 6 (that list only has music/dance syllabi). The syllabus is pp. 1-4 of the Teachers' Guide above; not downloaded separately.
